a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (reach 8 first) almost certainly gets us both killed. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you rather than doing it behind your back. If you'd rather propose a different split or plan, say so. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither of us reaches 4. After I take, I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. That breaks our original agreement, and I own that. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
